page.overview:
Who is Paparazzi ponies?

The Shutterbugs are six ponies who appear as paparazzi in various episodes in the series, consisting of Earth ponies Long Shot and Snappy Scoop, unicorn Press Release, and Pegasi Big Shot, Eff Stop, and Tracy Flash. They are unnamed in the show, but they are named varyingly in merchandise and other depictions.

Long Shot and Big Shot are similar in coat and mane colors, cutie mark, and name. Snappy Scoop and Tracy Flash have the same cutie mark. Press Release shares her coat and eye colors with Sweetie Drops, Fine Line, "Roma", "Paisley Pastel", "Cultivar", S05E21 Unnamed Earth Mare #1, and "Hazel Harvest". Eff Stop bears a resemblance to "Icy Drop", and he shares his cutie mark with Press Release.

Snappy Scoop, Big Shot, and Eff Stop appear again outside the Grand Galloping Gala in The Best Night Ever.

In season two, Long Shot, Snappy Scoop, and Press Release appear in The Mysterious Mare Do Well as Rainbow Dash's paparazzi when she becomes famous after performing several acts of heroism.
